headline: BHP AVERTS ESCONDIDA STRIKE — TENTATIVE DEAL WITH SUPERVISORS UNION HEADS TO MEMBER RATIFICATION VOTE
snippet: BHP reached a tentative wage agreement with the Escondida supervisors' union after last-minute mediation, averting an imminent strike at the world's largest copper mine. The deal — representing over 2,000 workers — must now be ratified by membership; a rejection triggers an immediate work stoppage.

headline: GOLD SLIDES TO $4,142 FOR THIRD STRAIGHT LOSS — U.S. CPI AND OCT. 27-28 FED MEETING NOW THE ONLY CATALYSTS
snippet: Spot gold fell 0.3% to $4,142.85 per ounce on Wednesday as traders awaited the September U.S. CPI report. The metal has retreated roughly $1,400 from its January record high of $5,560, with analysts watching $4,100 as key technical support and the October 27-28 Fed meeting as the next major catalyst.

headline: GOLD FIELDS CEO TOURS AUSTRALIA ON $27B NORTHERN STAR BID — CASH SWEETENER UNDER CONSIDERATION
snippet: Gold Fields CEO Mike Fraser is touring Perth, Sydney and Melbourne to win shareholder support for the A$39 billion bid for Northern Star Resources. The South African miner is weighing a higher cash component after Northern Star's board called the initial offer 'highly opportunistic' and activist Elliott Management built a stake.

headline: CHINESE LITHIUM FUTURES CRASH 11.8% TO 10-MONTH LOW — EU-CHINA HYBRID CAR DEAL SHATTERS BATTERY DEMAND HOPES
snippet: Chinese lithium carbonate futures plunged 11.8% on October 12 to their lowest level since December 2025, as a China-EU deal reducing hybrid car exports crushed near-term battery demand expectations. Tianqi Lithium and Ganfeng Lithium shed 5% each while Goldman Sachs forecast the spot price falling to 100,000 yuan/tonne by 2027.

headline: COPPER DEMAND FORECAST TO SURGE 50% BY 2040 — MINED SUPPLY PEAKS 2030 IN WIDENING STRUCTURAL DEFICIT
snippet: A new industry forecast projects copper demand rising 50% by 2040 while mined supply is expected to peak around 2030, widening a structural deficit. EVs and grid infrastructure are the primary demand drivers, raising long-term questions about whether the junior mining pipeline can fill the gap.

headline: RECORD CENTRAL BANK GOLD BUYING ISN'T SAVING MINERS — 289 TONNES PURCHASED, STOCKS STILL TRAIL SPOT 2-5X
snippet: Despite record central bank gold purchases of 289 tonnes, gold mining equities are underperforming spot gold by 2-5x in 2026. All-in sustaining costs surged 16% year-over-year to $1,785 per ounce in Q1, with royalty and streaming companies largely insulated from the cost squeeze.

headline: AURO RESOURCES INTERCEPTS 572.5M AT 0.60 g/t AuEq IN ECUADOR — COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY SCALE CONFIRMED
snippet: Auro Resources (TSX-V: AURO) intersected 572.5 metres grading 0.60 g/t gold-equivalent from 72.5 metres depth at its Santa Barbara project in Ecuador. The broad copper-gold porphyry interval firmly establishes system scale and sets the stage for a major resource estimate.

headline: GOLD X2 MINING HITS COMBINED 172M AT 0.96 g/t AU — BULK INFILL DRILLING CONFIRMS DEPOSIT CONTINUITY
snippet: Gold X2 Mining (TSX-V: AUXX) drilled a combined 172.0 metres at 0.96 g/t gold in infill drilling at its Main and Southwest zones. The company says results will have a significant impact on its Q1 2027 mineral resource estimate update.

headline: GALANTAS GOLD HITS MINERALIZATION IN ALL 6 HOLES AT INDIANA, CHILE — NEW STRUCTURES PUSH BEYOND RESOURCE BOUNDARY
snippet: Galantas Gold (TSX-V: GAL) confirmed all six drill holes at its Indiana gold-copper project in Chile returned mineralized intersections, with the majority hitting newly identified structures outside the current Mineral Resource Estimate. The results signal meaningful upside to existing inventory.

headline: LUCA MINING CLOSES C$211M FINANCING — COZAMIN COPPER ACQUISITION FROM CAPSTONE ON TRACK FOR LATE OCTOBER
snippet: Luca Mining (TSX-V: LUCA) completed a C$211 million subscription receipt financing to fund its US$290 million acquisition of Capstone Copper's Cozamin polymetallic mine in Zacatecas, Mexico. The deal is expected to close in late October and will more than double Luca's 2027 production profile.

headline: JAGUAR URANIUM DELIVERS MAIDEN RESOURCE AT LAGUNA SALADA — ARGENTINA ASSERTS ITSELF AS URANIUM ADDRESS
snippet: Jaguar Uranium announced a maiden mineral resource estimate at its Laguna Salada project in Argentina on October 13, adding to a growing roster of advanced-stage uranium projects outside Kazakhstan and Australia. The estimate marks the project's first formally classified resource and positions the company for development decisions.

headline: SKYLINE MERGER PUTS KAZAKH TUNGSTEN IN PLAY — Q4 2026 CLOSE TARGETED IN RARE NON-CHINA CRITICAL MINERAL DEAL
snippet: A merger involving Skyline would bring Kazakh tungsten assets into a publicly-listed vehicle, with Q4 2026 or early Q1 2027 targeted for closing pending regulatory approvals. Tungsten is a critical industrial metal with almost no significant non-Chinese Western-aligned supply.
